title: Corridor step 2 — BCCR proposes the CRC/CLP pair
description: Only the Central Bank that issues token A may propose. The service deploys a dedicated per-pair AMM bound to (token_a, token_b) and returns the pair in PROPOSED status.
notes: Gateway: BCCR (Banco Central de Costa Rica) Central Bank gateway, spoke-crc. Requires the central_bank realm role — note that /api/v2 uses lowercase unprefixed roles, while /api/v1 uses the ROLE_-prefixed ones; both namespaces coexist in the same token's roles array. Omit amm_address unless you know exactly why you are setting it: supplying a shared or bootstrap AMM mis-binds the pool and makes every later add-liquidity call revert. The 201 here is another delivered-vs-documented divergence (the platform declares 200 with no schema). Undocumented upstream: 409 PAIR_ALREADY_EXISTS / PAIR_ALREADY_ACTIVE, 404 PAIR_NOT_FOUND, and a 403 carrying code NOT_CENTRAL_BANK_OF_TOKEN_A.
